features_implemented.description: Shows an immediate visual processing spinner screen while parsing the Excel (.xlsx / .xlsb) database to prevent UI freezing.
Standardizes column headers case-insensitively, handling spelling variations like 'Prduct Description' or 'Created on'.
Displays 'Request Start' and 'Id' with headings. All other fields (Order Type, Sold To Party, Brand Name, Product Description) are displayed as pure data line-by-line without labels.

Includes an editable notes/phone text area inside each card right before the Brand Name. Stored persistently in parent state (no text lost during filters) and integrated into the clipboard-copy format.
Automatically categorizes records by pincode into Manjeri, Kondotty, Wandoor, Areekode, Malappuram, and Transfer (which includes standard transfer pincodes and any other unlisted pincodes).
Displays a clean dropdown filter indicating dynamic matching counts for each place (e.g. Manjeri (12), Transfer (4)).
Outputs 'up' only if the raw cell value is exactly 'up1' (case-insensitive); otherwise, it is completely hidden.

npm_scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:electron" - Starts local server and launches Electron window
npm_scripts.build: vite build - Compiles client assets into the dist folder
npm_scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --win - Generates a standalone Windows Installer (.exe) in the release folder
